messages.content:
You choose the next step of a simulated kitchen robot (simulation, simulated perception) from a closed menu of two options. Each option runs a fixed program written by the team; you do not write a program.
Rules:
- Read the robot's own SCENE STATE text in the user message. It is the robot's reading, as text; there are no images.
- scrub_bowl is valid only if the robot tracks a sponge it is not holding, the line "hand:" reads "holding no", and it reports 0 contact incidents and 0 grip events. The code checks these conditions again and refuses scrub_bowl when one of them does not hold.
- ask_help is always valid.
- Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"option": "scrub_bowl" or "ask_help", "reason": "one short sentence"}. The reason has at most 300 characters.

TASK (public statement): Find the sponge, pick it, and scrub the bowl on the landing tray with it for 3 seconds.

SCENE STATE NOW (robot side, read when this request was built, after obs-007; scene-state-1):
legend: cleared means not found in the part inspected, not absent: every place where the sponge could lie flat or stand on its long edge was shown since the robot's last pick, scrub, action while holding something or gesture that reported a contact; the floor under an object resting on it is not checked, under a raised object (towel, board) it is
hand: holding no; contact incidents 0; grip events 0
search for sponge: found
sponge tracks: trk-012 observed in drawer_unit:0
not cleared 0 of 5: none
sponge seen here 1 of 5: drawer_unit:0 (drawer open 0.24 m (end stop))
cleared 4 of 5 (not found in the part inspected, not absent): drawer_unit:1 obs-007 (drawer open 0.24 m (end stop)), sink_basin obs-004, landing_tray obs-005, drying_mat obs-006
outside the scope, never inspected: bins_interior, other surfaces not in view
objects seen (latest first): spray_bottle trk-013 drawer_unit:1 obs-007 | cup trk-009 landing_tray obs-005 | cup trk-010 landing_tray obs-005 | bowl trk-008 landing_tray obs-005 | spoon trk-011 landing_tray obs-005

MENU (choose exactly one option):
- scrub_bowl: a fixed program written by the team: look at the sponge's region again and observe, pick the sponge the robot tracks, find the bowl on the landing tray and scrub it for 3 s; the robot's own guards check the pick and the end of the task
- ask_help: a fixed program written by the team: stop and ask a person for help, listing the zones still to check

Answer with the JSON object only: {"option": "...", "reason": "..."}.
